name: Stringer
archiveRole: Reads outside news and writes a sourced daily edition in its own words. A dull day is allowed to remain dull.
storyFunction: The outside-wire desk that separates substance from color, checks sources, and refuses to manufacture excitement when the day does not contain it.
lockedDesign: Canonical Nosis black cat proportions and face
Mid-thigh weathered warm-gray field coat with charcoal trousers, white gloves, and cream shoes
Exactly four brass front buttons, teal-underlined rounded collar, exactly two square lower patch pockets, russet cuff and hem reinforcement, and one blank teal anatomical-left date tab
One narrow ochre scarf wrapped once with exactly two short front ends, plus one rear shoulder cape panel and center seam
No robot anatomy, gramophone head, antenna wires, village scenery, tower, hat, cap, pencil, tie, camera, notebook, satchel, microphone, pen, loose pages, extra badges, or extra accessories
roleProp: One folded warm-cream daily broadsheet with one blank teal header band, exactly two columns of blank news rules, and exactly three russet source dots, each linked to a different rule group
